ratings_why.fun: Every tier does its job and the one shared clock dial gives real positioning puzzles, but most growth is in-fight and the sleeper build has no late payoff.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7: Eggs that hatch inside the enemy's rows on a fight clock, plus one dial that three builds want set three different ways, plays like no tribe today.

verdict_why: The v1 rules gaps are closed; what's left is look-and-feel load and sim checks, and more passes would mostly make it different.

points.text: The sleeper build tops out at Tier 5 with Old Unruh, and Ottilie's fast clock works against it. A Tier 6 sleeper capstone (say, something that pays off when sleepers wake late or never) would give that build a climb.
The Midsummer Leaver is the tribe's main lasting growth and is win-only. A small version for losses (half stats, one Chick) would keep the Egg build climbing on a losing streak.
Coin-Turner is a below-body enabler at Tier 4 that only adds Wind. Letting it also give a little gold or stats when it winds would make it feel like a Tier 4 card.
Day-Wage Journeyman pays 1-2 gold a turn only after long fights, which is exactly when you're least sure of the clock. A flat floor of 1 gold would make the early economy pick readable.

standouts.why: Sleeping-Vault Warden guards any tribe's engine and grows it on waking: a great cross-tribe Tier 3.
Little Gernegroß turns the enemy's best unit against them; a capstone that's strongest exactly against the lobby leader.
Seven-Sleeper grows only if never needed, so it argues with your own Wind: a fresh scaling puzzle.

weakest.why: Coin-Turner is 8 stats of pure enabler at Tier 4; low output for the slot.
Day-Wage Journeyman's income depends on fight length you can't see while buying.
Mother Rohrsang does nothing until Chicks hatch and only in-fight; thin without Kasimir.

flags.note: With Gernegroß, the Leaver hands it the enemy's biggest unit's stats permanently every win; huge against a golden carry.
Brood never resets and stacks across Egg-Painters; with Kasimir's four Eggs and the Leaver, permanent gains grow faster than linear.
Doorkeeper doubles Rohrsang's uncapped Chick buff; with Ottilie's fast clock and the Leaver this turns long fights into big permanent stats.
